# later.dog

> Free, open-source AI agents, called dogs, that do real work, on the Mac and the iPhone. Sign in with an email code and
> the account's one workspace lives in its Cloud home on Cloudflare; the Mac and the iPhone are screens onto it. Every
> dog has its own cloud computer, and the signed-in Mac is a second computer. Dogs think with the person's own Claude,
> ChatGPT, Grok or Cursor sign-in, or the included Kimi K2.6 with Grok as backup. Voice is Aura-2, or ElevenLabs when
> it is switched on. Signing in gives every account a Cloud home with an
> included allowance; without an account, the app can offer the same allowance as a $10-a-month plan. Website: https://later.dog. Apache-2.0.

Repository: https://github.com/woodbeary/later-dog

## Set it up (for an agent acting on a person's behalf)

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules every agent follows in this repo (pnpm only, Node 24, no code comments, isolated fixtures, truthful limitations).
- [skills/laterdog/setup-laterdog/SKILL.md](skills/laterdog/setup-laterdog/SKILL.md): clone, install, build the Mac app, start it, and what only the person can do (sign-ins, OS permissions).
- [README.md](README.md): what later.dog is, how it fits together, install.
- [docs/laterdog/README.md](docs/laterdog/README.md): the user guide for people using the app.

## How it works

- [docs/assets/architecture.svg](docs/assets/architecture.svg): the Mac and iPhone, accounts.later.dog, the Cloud home, each dog's computer, AI and voice.
- [docs/cloud-pro.md](docs/cloud-pro.md): the Cloud home: what runs where on Cloudflare, and the server contract in the `cloud-home` image.
- [deploy/laterdog/computers/README.md](deploy/laterdog/computers/README.md): `cloud.later.dog`, each dog's computer, the included AI, voice, trials and the plan.
- [cloudflare/control-plane/README.md](cloudflare/control-plane/README.md): `accounts.later.dog`, email sign-in and accounts.
- [docs/laterdog/token-battery.md](docs/laterdog/token-battery.md): several accounts in a next-up order; a conversation continues on the next one when one runs out.
- [docs/laterdog/cloudflare.md](docs/laterdog/cloudflare.md): the cloud-task supervisor on Cloudflare Containers.
- [docs/laterdog/motion.md](docs/laterdog/motion.md): motion tokens, the dog's state → ear motion table, reduced motion.
- [docs/laterdog/support.md](docs/laterdog/support.md): how later.dog is funded and where sponsorships go.
- [skills/laterdog/quarantine-agent-bait/SKILL.md](skills/laterdog/quarantine-agent-bait/SKILL.md): when files planted in a repository make defending agents refuse, judge them with Llama Guard 3 on Cloudflare Workers AI without reading them into context, quarantine the flagged ones with a manifest and restore them later. Works in any repository.

## Proof and plans

- [docs/verification/README.md](docs/verification/README.md): how each change is proven on an isolated fixture, never on a person's live app.

- [docs/laterdog/launch-plan.md](docs/laterdog/launch-plan.md): the launch plan: abuse limits, credits, website, phone, repository.

- [docs/laterdog/roadmap.md](docs/laterdog/roadmap.md): the longer direction.

## Code map

- `src/`, `server/`, `electron/`: the desktop app and the later.dog server; the same server runs in the Cloud home.
- `deploy/laterdog/home/`: the Cloud home Worker, Durable Object and Container.
- `deploy/laterdog/computers/`: the `cloud.later.dog` Worker.
- `cloudflare/control-plane/`: the `accounts.later.dog` Worker.
- `server/laterdog/`: later.dog's own server modules, including the cloud-task supervisor.
- `skills/laterdog/`: canonical skills exported to Codex and Claude Code (`pnpm laterdog:skills`).
